instruction: Set the editor tab size to 2 spaces in VS Code settings.

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing VS Code settings to set the tab size to 2 spaces. The evaluator uses the existing check_json_settings function to verify that settings.json contains 'editor.tabSize': 2.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly fetches VS Code settings.json from the standard Linux location (/home/user/.config/Code/User/settings.json)
Metric logic correctly parses JSON and verifies that 'editor.tabSize': 2 exists with exact value match using strict equality
Expected parameter handling is CORRECT: when type='rule', framework calls get_rule which returns config['rules'], and metric correctly accesses expected['expected'] to get the actual settings dict
Complete coverage: instruction requires setting tab size to 2 spaces, evaluator checks exactly this single requirement
Expected value is semantically correct: 'editor.tabSize': 2 is the proper VS Code setting for 2-space tabs as documented in VS Code settings
State accessibility: settings.json is file-based and persists after VS Code closes, verification is reliable without UI dependency
Robust edge case handling: metric uses sentinel pattern to distinguish missing keys from None values, handles JSON parse errors, missing files
Postconfig present (relaunches VS Code) though not strictly necessary for file-based settings verification

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_json_settings first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
metric check_json_settings second parameter type (str) may not match expected.rules type (Dict)
